# Printables generated by OpenAI image model

- **Date:** 2026-11-13
- **Decided by:** Haylee

**Decision:** Each printable page is colorable black-and-white line art generated by OpenAI's Images API (gpt-image-2, best-documented ID; verify at build time). Claude still writes the structured kit spec, and the app turns each item into an image prompt. Pages are assembled into one PDF for the AirPrint sheet. The bundled airplane fallback ships pre-generated images.

**Why:** Haylee wants really nice art over app-drawn blocks. Image models spell well enough now, and kids are forgiving. This replaces C8. Open: whether names go into image prompts (privacy) or are overlaid by the app.
